script.problem: Moment 2's passage Numbers 23:1-6 doesn't include a verse that names Bamoth-baal in the lessons.

terra.problem: “Seven altars and a message” does not say that Balaam went off to a barren height before God met him. The passage does not establish whether that height was at Bamoth-baal.
“Seven altars and a message” says Balaam had Balak offer the animals, but the passage says Balak and Balaam offered them together. Balaam told Balak to build the altars and prepare the animals.
